title: The payer's contact sees only invoices that name the payer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use a shop that uses the customer portal.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for, with contact A1, who can sign in to the customer portal.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, with contact B1, who can sign in to the customer portal.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced for $150.00, unpaid, billed to customer B.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer A, invoiced, that bills itself, so customer A has another job the payer must not see.
custom_steps:
1. Sign in to the customer portal as contact B1.
  2. Open the list of invoices and jobs.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Contact B1, customer B's contact, is signed in.

Step 2:

  • Work order 1's invoice is listed.
  • Work order 2 is not listed.
  • Customer A's assets are not shown.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12318 (Story 16, Customer portal)
